title: S-M10 Urban TC-3

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Alpinestars S-M10 Urban TC-3 is delivers competition-grade off-road impact absorption with maximum cooling throughput, pairing extreme cooling throughput with competition-grade roost protection. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1307g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~100 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Top MX with full carbon shell and A-Head fitting system.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: The Alpinestars S-M10 Urban TC-3 is a motocross/dirt bike helmet designed for off-road use. It features an open-face design typical of MX helmets, which generally does not accommodate full-face specific technologies like MIPS (rotational mitigation), HUD mounts, or deep speaker pockets found on street/full-face models. The fit is typically aggressive and narrow to suit MX riding positions, optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Alpinestars S-M10 Urban TC-3: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Alpinestars S-M10 Urban TC-3: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Alpinestars S-M10 Urban TC-3. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in Alpinestars's Dirt / MX lineup, the S-M10 Urban TC-3 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Alpinestars S-M10 Urban TC-3 represents Alpinestars's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~100 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Alpinestars S-M10 Urban TC-3 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
